##### Project general facts

Azha Views Residences by Azha Properties is a contemporary residential tower designed around comfort, functionality and modern living. Elegant architecture combines clean lines with efficient space planning, while the tower rises above a ground floor and four podium levels to twenty-five residential floors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom homes with a study and two-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, private balconies and open-plan living areas suited to a wide range of lifestyles.

Residents enjoy a large swimming pool and a fully equipped gym for an active routine, along with landscaped communal spaces and dedicated social areas that create a welcoming environment. A multi-level car park, lifts and round-the-clock security add everyday comfort and peace of mind, while nearby shops, schools, parks, recreation areas, restaurants and medical facilities make daily life practical and convenient for families and professionals living in the tower.

Residences feature modern finishes and high-quality materials throughout, with built-in wardrobes, well-proportioned living spaces and large windows that bring in plenty of natural light. Thoughtful layouts make efficient use of space and create comfortable, practical homes. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with equipped kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Amerah is a growing residential district of Ajman, set within Emirates City and close to Al Helio, known for its calm, family-friendly streets, modern towers and expanding retail and services. Parks, mosques, supermarkets and schools serve local families, while the beaches, corniche and cultural attractions of Ajman and Sharjah are within easy reach for weekends and leisure time.

Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Al Rashidiya Park and the Ajman Corniche are a short drive away, while Ajman City Centre, Ajman University and Al Zorah are within comfortable reach, as are Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport for frequent travellers.

Ajman offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible prices in the UAE. Spacious apartments with a long, flexible payment plan attract first-time buyers, families and investors seeking value. Strong road links to Dubai and Sharjah support steady demand from tenants working across the emirates, underpinning attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
